note: What the office-hours scene says of the constituent's case (src/director/constituent-help-facts.ts caseFacts): which office the case is referred to when the official takes it up, by the case's problem (constituent-cases.ts resolve: a wage complaint goes to the labor standards office, a job seeker to the workforce office), and how the office's other open cases are said. Words only; nothing here is a number the world runs on.

agencyByProblem.spread: Names only: the office constituent-cases.ts refers each problem to (raiseOne for a wage complaint, recordReferral for a job seeker).

otherCases.spread: Words only: the official's other open cases (openCasesOf), said as a count in words.

moneyLeft.spread: Words only, a sliding scale: how a job seeker says their savings stand from their case's severity (constituent-cases.ts problemOf: one less the months their savings last over caseCushionMonths); never a figure (rule no-figures-people-would-not-know). Bands checked at thirds.
moneyLeft.checkedAgainst: The owner's rule no-figures-people-would-not-know (people say how savings stand, not how many months).
